After discovering that AI crawlers were routinely ignoring robots.txt files, Patreon integrated Cloudflare's AI Crawl Control to actively block unauthorized training bots while still allowing search indexers.

While blocking scrapers protects creators, it may accelerate the consolidation of AI training data toward massive, closed-door licensing deals that exclude independent platforms.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
No plane error detected. The stated intent (protecting creators) matches the physical implementation (blocking unauthorized IP traffic at the CDN level).

Social Physics Analysis:
By shifting from passive honor-system rules to active technical enforcement, Patreon reduces systemic exploitation. This transparent alignment of platform and creator interests builds deep trust and solidarity.

The Trajectory: The Path of Greater Good.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Good. Active defense of creator rights preserves the value of human labor.

The Unavoidable Truth: AI companies routinely ignore polite requests and standard web protocols to harvest data.

The Unavoidable Lie: The robots.txt file is a sufficient tool for protecting intellectual property in the AI era.

Alethekanon:
The transition from normative rules to hard technical constraints is a logical necessity when dealing with predatory data acquisition. Patreon's move is structurally sound.
